component.name: Legion Control
component.summary: Fans, profiles, RGB and sensors for Lenovo Legion laptops

description.p: Unofficial control center for Lenovo Legion laptops: fan tuning, platform power profiles, battery charge limits, Spectrum RGB lighting (including a per-key painter), Curve Optimizer, and live sensor dashboards.

The Flatpak ships the settings UI only. Privileged hardware control is performed by the legion-control daemon, which is installed on the host from a native package and reached over a dedicated system socket — exactly the same split the portable AppImage uses.
Initial Flatpak packaging of the settings UI.
